issues.title: Missing timeout for Step 5 (Copy & Run)
issues.why: The normative contract in 00-overview.md specifies the backend must bind to its port within 30s, but does not define the behavior if it fails (e.g., process hangs or port conflict).
issues.fix: Add a 'Timeout Handling' column to the Step 5 row specifying a 30s wait-loop with a '9533 ERR_GO_RUN_FAILED' exit on timeout.

issues.title: Unspecified behavior for partial clean failures
issues.why: The -Force flag removes multiple paths; if one file is locked (e.g., by an IDE), the spec doesn't clarify if the runner should abort or warn and continue.
issues.fix: In 00-overview.md Step 3, specify that clean failures on non-critical paths (like .db) should warn, while failures on .pnp.cjs must abort.

issues.title: Missing winget version check logic
issues.why: 07-runner-interface.md says 'do not auto-upgrade existing user installs' but doesn't define the exit code if a tool exists but is below the minimum required version.
issues.fix: Add a rule to Step 2 in 00-overview.md stating that sub-minimum versions trigger a warning but allow the pipeline to proceed at user risk.
